statement: Spontaneous home-cage movement recorded early in the paradigm carries information about where an animal's later composite outcome will fall, prospectively
evidence_basis: frozen Figure 1 bridge; association and held-out prediction
prohibited_reading: that early movement causes the later outcome

statement: Spatially resolved hippocampal proteomics recovers reproducible anatomical organisation whose resolution differs between compartments
evidence_basis: Results 2
prohibited_reading: that resolution is uniform, or that compartments are purified populations

statement: Later outcomes are accompanied by few robust individual-protein differences but by coordinated molecular-program differences across spatial contexts
evidence_basis: Results 3
prohibited_reading: that program-level detection is more truthful than protein-level testing

statement: We did not find evidence joining the behavioural and proteomic findings and do not present them as a chain
resolves_to_claim: BH-006 as recorded in figure1_bridge_conflicts.csv and Results 4
evidence_basis: edge-behaviour analysis, 0 of 48 tests supported
prohibited_reading: that an integration exists but was omitted

statement: The predictor cannot have been shaped by the outcome or by the grouping, because the window closes before any outcome component is measured
evidence_basis: frozen timeline contract; design fact
prohibited_reading: that temporal precedence establishes mechanism

statement: The association carries predictive information about individual animals rather than describing only a group-level trend
evidence_basis: held-out prediction exceeding a full-refit permutation null
prohibited_reading: that prediction is accurate, or that binary phenotype is predicted

statement: An R2 near 0.16 leaves most variation unexplained; the appropriate reading is that early behaviour contains some prospective information, not that outcome can be anticipated
evidence_basis: LOAO R2 against an intercept-only baseline
prohibited_reading: that the model is useful for individual-animal forecasting

statement: What the early movement signal represents is not resolved; trait, early stress response and mediator cannot be distinguished by this design
evidence_basis: design fact; no manipulation, no repeated pre-exposure baseline
prohibited_reading: that any one of the listed interpretations is supported over the others

statement: Cage identity was not represented in the analysis design, so cage-level dependence could not be assessed; this bounds generalisation and is not a leakage route
evidence_basis: frozen bridge FM-12 and F1-10
prohibited_reading: that cage structure invalidates the prediction

statement: Formal feature-by-sex interaction tests were unsupported; we claim neither a sex-specific relationship nor equivalence between sexes
evidence_basis: frozen bridge F1-08, all interaction q = 0.90
prohibited_reading: that the relationship is female-specific, or that it is proven identical

statement: Compartment rather than experimental group dominates global dataset structure, which is the ordering a spatial experiment is designed to produce
evidence_basis: joint PCA variance decomposition, descriptive
prohibited_reading: that the decomposition is a hypothesis test

statement: Distinctions within CA1 strata and among microglia-enriched regional contrasts warrant more conservative interpretation
evidence_basis: bilateral concordance inventory
prohibited_reading: that CA1 laminar results are invalid

statement: The microglia-enriched compartment is a local microenvironment sampled to favour microglia, not a purified population, and reference affinity is contextual support rather than proof of cell-intrinsic origin
evidence_basis: sampling definition; external-reference validation scope
prohibited_reading: that any microglial signal is cell-intrinsic

statement: Protein-level testing and ranked enrichment ask different questions of the same data; a result where the second detects structure the first does not is the expected consequence of that difference
evidence_basis: separate multiple-testing families; never placed on a common scale
prohibited_reading: that enrichment is more sensitive and therefore more true

statement: The seven program families do not constitute seven independent mechanistic findings; the atlas is descriptive and computes no theme-level significance
evidence_basis: curated atlas definition; no theme-level P or FDR
prohibited_reading: that each family is a separate supported mechanism

statement: Leading-edge membership is not a protein-level result; none of the displayed values is individually supported after correction
evidence_basis: smallest BH FDR 0.53 among displayed leading-edge values
prohibited_reading: that leading-edge proteins are validated differential proteins

statement: The correlation-aware competitive analysis is a sensitivity analysis on the same ranked statistics, not independent replication
evidence_basis: direction concordant, inferential support attenuated
prohibited_reading: that it independently replicates the enrichment result

statement: Program differences are resolved across distinct spatial contexts; the unevenness of supported cells was observed but not tested
evidence_basis: omnibus heterogeneity tests did not survive correction
prohibited_reading: spatially selective, spatially specific, region-specific, layer-specific, restricted

statement: The same program family may appear in more than one context, and the context of strongest phenotype effect need not be the context of strongest control-state affinity; this is contextual heterogeneity, not movement of a program
evidence_basis: descriptive atlas structure
prohibited_reading: relocation, redistribution or migration of programs between compartments

statement: The initial concentration of supported proteins in CA2-SLM does not survive quality-control scrutiny and is reported as qualified; CA2-SLM is not a molecular hotspot
evidence_basis: missingness audit, normalisation displacement tracking missingness, robustness criteria
prohibited_reading: that CA2-SLM is a molecular hotspot

statement: Directional signs were stable under leave-one-animal-out resampling, so the concern is magnitude separability from a normalisation artefact rather than instability across animals
evidence_basis: robustness analysis
prohibited_reading: that the CA2-SLM effects are confirmed

statement: No module-by-contrast cell survived correction in the neuropil, none across all compartments, and no stress-by-spatial omnibus test was supported; this is failure to survive correction in the families tested
prohibited_reading: that no such effects exist, or that modules are supported resilience mechanisms

statement: Module membership and network position are properties of the correlation structure and add no statistical support to a protein's association with outcome
evidence_basis: topology versus inference distinction
prohibited_reading: that hub status is inferential evidence

statement: O-GlcNAcase, SLC22A23 and annexin A2 are named as candidates for orthogonal follow-up rather than established findings; none has been verified by an orthogonal method here
evidence_basis: protein-level support and robustness qualification where applicable; module position is topological
prohibited_reading: that any candidate is a validated mechanism

statement: The inferential sample is three animals per group, which limits protein-level detection and is why program-level analysis carries much of the interpretation
evidence_basis: design fact
prohibited_reading: that program-level analysis compensates for or substitutes for sample size

statement: Heterogeneous later outcomes are prospectively foreshadowed by early spontaneous behaviour and accompanied by coordinated hippocampal proteomic differences resolved across anatomical contexts; both halves are associations rather than mechanisms
evidence_basis: synthesis of the three results above
prohibited_reading: that either half is causal, global, or spatially specific

statement: Resilience and susceptibility labels summarise where an animal falls on a graded outcome distribution and are neither fixed types nor predictions about other contexts
evidence_basis: classification rule is a threshold on a continuous score
prohibited_reading: that RES and SUS are immutable biological types

statement: Statements about adolescent plasticity, outcome heterogeneity, endpoint-testing limitations, home-cage monitoring and hippocampal anatomy are general literature claims
evidence_basis: external literature; see citation_needs.csv CIT-01 to CIT-06
prohibited_reading: presenting these as findings of this study
